content.text: in these trying times, here's our guide to fanfic on tumblr. while we'll never be able to fill the @ao3org sized hole in your hearts, here are a few tumblr communities within some of the biggest fandoms on the platform that'll serve your creative needs 📖
#hollanov: hollanov stans | heated rivalry | scott x kip heated rivalry
#life series: life series | life series fandom on tumblr
#jujutsu kaisen: jujutsu kaisen | jujutsu kaisen fanfics
#hannibal: hannibalistic | hannibal fic
#bloodymary: bloodymary | patron saints of one way trips
#byler: byler nation | byler fanfic bookclub
and for all writers: ao3 writers readers fanfiction | fanfiction writers unite
